integrity: Self-contained symbolic proof and directly enumerated finite verifier; no external independent assessment has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly four positive alternating binary runs, linear contiguous factors, distinct factor strings; no claim about five or more runs or scattered subsequences.
The exact count and fixed-length maximum are proved for all integer parameters; finite checker cases are corroborative and not substitutes for the proof.
An equivalent earlier formulation in unindexed literature remains possible, especially a hidden specialization of complement-factor enumeration.
title: Complementary-factor spectrum and sharp extremum for four-run binary words
